description.en: Ten independently authored hard engineering tasks built only around base-game Don't Starve Together APIs, prefabs, components, and assets.
description.zh: 十道独立设计的高难度工程题，仅使用《饥荒联机版》原版 API、prefab、组件与资源。

title.zh: 服务端权威营地燃料配给器

summary.en: Ration a shared fuel depot to tracked fires by priority class and integer max-min fairness, reserving each share until the real fueled component has accepted it.
summary.zh: 按优先级分类和整数 max-min 公平把共享燃料库配给给被跟踪的火堆，每份配额在真实 fueled 组件接受之前只是预留。

brief.en: Create a pure integer allocator plus a master-simulation world component. Players deposit whitelisted fuel items from their real inventory into a bounded depot; each round the server reports real fuel levels, plans shares class by class with water-filling, a per-round cap and a reserve floor, adds fuel through fueled:DoDelta, commits what was really accepted, rolls back the rest, and persists depot, open round, request history and contributions.
brief.zh: 创建纯整数配给核心和主模拟世界组件。玩家把白名单内的燃料物品从真实库存存入有容量上限的燃料库；每轮由服务端上报真实燃料水位，按优先级逐类做注水式分配（含单轮上限与保底库存），通过 fueled:DoDelta 加燃料，按真实接受量提交、其余回滚，并持久化库存、未结束轮次、请求历史与玩家贡献。

en: Export Allocator.new(options), Allocator.load(data, options), deposit(request_id, player_id, units, now), lookup(request_id, player_id), register(consumer_id, priority, capacity, now), unregister(consumer_id, now), report(consumer_id, level, now), plan(round_id, now), commit(round_id, consumer_id, delivered_units, now), abort(round_id, consumer_id, now), close(round_id, now), snapshot(now), and save(now).

Validate in the published order: finite non-negative non-decreasing time, identifiers of 1 to 64 characters, then integer quantities; reject fractions, NaN, infinities, negatives and non-numbers with the published codes and without changing state or the clock.

Deduplicate deposits by (player_id, request_id), replaying the first recorded outcome; accept only the free space of the depot (partial), reject with depot_full when none is free, and count reserved units against depot_capacity.

Plan class by class in ascending priority; inside a class hand out one unit at a time to the unsatisfied consumer holding the fewest units, ties to the smallest consumer id, never above min(demand, max_units_per_round) and never touching reserve_floor units.
Allow one open round; a plan retry with the open id returns the identical shares without reserving again, another id is round_open, and closed ids answer round_closed forever.

Settle each share exactly once: commit delivers at most the planned units and returns the rest, abort returns everything, repeats replay the first settlement, close aborts pending shares, and unregistering a consumer aborts its pending share.
Treat report time as measurement time: strictly older than the consumer's last report is stale, levels clamp to capacity, and reports never touch the global clock.

Snapshots are fresh and deterministically ordered; save/load round-trips plain data including clock, an open round with partially settled shares, request history, closed round ids and per-player contributions. The world component runs only on the master simulation and persists this state through OnSave/OnLoad.
zh: 导出 Allocator.new(options)、Allocator.load(data, options)、deposit、lookup、register、unregister、report、plan、commit、abort、close、snapshot 与 save，参数顺序以题面为准。
按公布顺序校验：有限、非负、不回退的时间，1 到 64 字符的标识，再到整数数量；小数、NaN、无穷、负数和非 number 以公布的错误码拒绝，且不改变状态和时钟。
存入按 (player_id, request_id) 去重并重放首次结果；只接受燃料库的剩余空间（partial），没有空间时以 depot_full 拒绝，预留单位同样占用 depot_capacity。
按优先级升序逐类分配；类内每次把一个单位给当前分得最少且未满足的消费者，平局取最小 consumer id，不超过 min(demand, max_units_per_round)，且不动用 reserve_floor。
同一时间只允许一个未结束轮次；用同一 id 重试 plan 返回完全相同的份额且不重复预留，其它 id 返回 round_open，已关闭的 id 永远返回 round_closed。
每份配额恰好结算一次：commit 最多交付计划单位并退回其余，abort 全部退回，重复调用重放首次结算，close 中止未结算份额，注销消费者会中止其未结算份额。
report 的时间是测量时间：严格早于该消费者上次上报的为 stale，水位按 capacity 截断，且 report 不读写全局时钟。
快照为新表且顺序确定；save/load 以纯数据往返时钟、含部分结算份额的未结束轮次、请求历史、已关闭轮次 id 与玩家贡献。世界组件仅在主模拟运行，并通过 OnSave/OnLoad 持久化该状态。

en: Attach with AddPrefabPostInit("world", ...) behind inst.ismastersim and inst:AddComponent("fuelration"); register AddModRPCHandler("rhenium_fuel", "deposit", function(player, request_id, item_prefab, count)) and take identity from player.userid.

Read entity.components.fueled.maxfuel and currentfuel; capacity = floor(maxfuel / 15), level = min(capacity, ceil(currentfuel / 15)); deliver with fueled:DoDelta(units * 15) and commit floor((after - before) / 15) clamped to the planned units.
Check inventory:Has(prefab, count) and remove with inventory:ConsumeByName(prefab, count) (or RemoveItem) all-or-nothing, crediting the depot only after the items are gone.

Listen with ListenForEvent("onremove", fn, entity) per tracked entity and remove the same function with RemoveEventCallback in Untrack and OnRemoveFromEntity; run rounds from self.inst:DoPeriodicTask and cancel the task with task:Cancel().

Expose Track, Untrack, Deposit, RunRound, Snapshot, OnSave, OnLoad and OnRemoveFromEntity; OnLoad keeps time non-decreasing although GetTime() restarts, closes a restored open round and reconciles consumers with the entities still tracked.
zh: 在 inst.ismastersim 保护下用 AddPrefabPostInit("world", ...) 与 inst:AddComponent("fuelration") 挂载；注册 AddModRPCHandler("rhenium_fuel", "deposit", function(player, request_id, item_prefab, count))，身份取自 player.userid。

读取 entity.components.fueled.maxfuel 与 currentfuel；capacity = floor(maxfuel / 15)，level = min(capacity, ceil(currentfuel / 15))；用 fueled:DoDelta(units * 15) 交付，并按 floor((after - before) / 15) 截断到计划单位后提交。
用 inventory:Has(prefab, count) 预检，用 inventory:ConsumeByName(prefab, count)（或 RemoveItem）整体移除，物品确实移除后才记入燃料库。
对每个被跟踪实体 ListenForEvent("onremove", fn, entity)，并在 Untrack 与 OnRemoveFromEntity 中用同一函数 RemoveEventCallback；用 self.inst:DoPeriodicTask 运行周期轮次并以 task:Cancel() 取消。
公开 Track、Untrack、Deposit、RunRound、Snapshot、OnSave、OnLoad 与 OnRemoveFromEntity；OnLoad 在 GetTime() 重新计时的情况下保持时间不回退，关闭恢复出的未结束轮次，并按仍被跟踪的实体对账消费者。

en: Units are conserved: deposited_total always equals available + reserved + delivered_total and the depot never goes negative.
Retried deposits, plans, commits, aborts and closes never move units twice.
Priority, fairness, the per-round cap and the reserve floor are visible in exact integer shares.
An open round with partially settled shares, request history and contributions survive save and load.
The dedicated server verifies real inventory removal, real fueled.currentfuel increases per share, release of removed fires, reload reconciliation and listener/task cleanup.
zh: 单位守恒：deposited_total 恒等于 available + reserved + delivered_total，库存不会为负。
重试的存入、计划、提交、中止与关闭不会让单位移动两次。
优先级、公平性、单轮上限和保底库存体现在精确的整数份额上。
含部分结算份额的未结束轮次、请求历史与玩家贡献在保存加载后保持一致。
专服验证真实库存扣除、真实 fueled.currentfuel 按份额上升、被移除火堆的释放、重载对账以及监听与任务清理。

hidden_cases: quantities and time are validated before any state change
deposits deduplicate and respect depot capacity
plan is priority ordered max-min fair with cap and floor
plan retries are identical and only one round is open
shares settle exactly once and rollback returns units
snapshots are fresh and save load preserves an open round
server_cases: fuelration is attached with server authority
deposit removes real items and credits the depot once
round fuels real fires by priority and fairness
removed fires are released and state survives reload
